pieces.name: Abu Simbel Colossi
pieces.note: Four seated colossi carved into the sandstone cliff glow in the morning sun as visitors walk up to the dark doorway and sand blows across the forecourt.

pieces.name: Acropolis Hill Dusk
pieces.note: The ancient temple on its rock glows gold above the white town at dusk, windows coming on below, cars on the avenue and swallows under a crescent moon.

pieces.name: Alhambra Hill Dusk
pieces.note: The red fortress-palace runs along its wooded hill at dusk below the snowy sierra, cypresses dark against it as the town's lights come on and swifts wheel.

pieces.name: Alien Wave
pieces.note: Rows of aliens march side to side and down while a cannon behind its bunkers picks them off.

pieces.name: Alpine Lake Village
pieces.note: Painted houses and a white needle spire line a still mountain lake, mirrored perfectly as a wooden boat rows across and swans glide by.

pieces.name: Amber Fort Elephants
pieces.note: Painted elephants climb the walled ramp to a honey-coloured hill fort as a boat rows across the lake below, the old wall snaking over the hills and kites wheeling overhead.

pieces.name: Amber Ledger Spreadsheet
pieces.note: An amber screen spreadsheet where the cell pointer moves to a figure, a new value is typed on the entry line, the totals recalculate and the sheet flips to a bar graph.

pieces.name: Amsterdam Canal Bicycles
pieces.note: A row of tall gabled canal houses glows at golden hour while cyclists ride along the quay and a glass-roofed boat glides down the canal.

pieces.name: Analog Wall Clock
pieces.note: A brass wall clock on a dark wall, hour, minute and second hands sweeping in proportion.

pieces.name: Andaman Teal Beach
pieces.note: An elephant swims through clear teal shallows off a white island beach at sunset, the tall forest standing at the sand's edge and the surf rolling in.

pieces.name: Lotus Pond Temple Dawn
pieces.note: Five lotus bud temple towers stand dark against the sunrise over a still pond of lotus leaves, as robed monks walk the bank and birds cross the sky.

pieces.name: API Request Inspector
pieces.note: A request inspector where API calls stream in with method, path, status and timing bars, and one is opened to show its headers.

pieces.name: Apollonian Gasket
pieces.note: An Apollonian gasket of shaded pearls, every gap filled by smaller tangent circles, while the view glides in toward a tangency point and back out.

pieces.name: Architecture Map
pieces.note: A system architecture map from clients through a CDN and load balancer to services and data stores, with requests flowing along every link.

pieces.name: Arctic Icebergs
pieces.note: Icebergs drift on a dark polar sea under a faint green aurora, the swell rolling past them.

pieces.name: Asteroid Belt
pieces.note: Lumpy, cratered asteroids tumble past at different depths, lit warm from one side by a distant sun.

pieces.name: Aurora Cabin Snowfall
pieces.note: Green northern lights fold slowly over a snowy log cabin with lit windows, chimney smoke and gently falling snow.

pieces.name: Aurora Curtains
pieces.note: Three folded ribbons of aurora, green, teal and rose, sway slowly across the whole sky while their rays drift along each curtain.

pieces.name: Autumn Forest
pieces.note: A path winds into orange and red autumn woods while leaves drift down through the light.

pieces.name: Autumn Harvest
pieces.note: Pumpkins and a hay bale sit before a wheat field swaying in the sunset while autumn leaves tumble down.

pieces.name: Autumn Pagoda Maples
pieces.note: A five tier pagoda stands among red maples on an autumn evening, with lanterns on an arched bridge and maple leaves drifting down.

pieces.name: Autumn Road Cyclist
pieces.note: A lone cyclist pedals along a forest road under orange and red autumn trees while leaves drift down through the low sunlight.

pieces.name: Bagan Temple Plain
pieces.note: Brick temples and spired pagodas stretch across the plain at sunset while an ox cart raises dust along the road and haze drifts between them.

pieces.name: Balloon Valley Sunrise
pieces.note: Hot air balloons drift and rise over layered valleys at sunrise while mist rolls through the low ground.

pieces.name: Bamboo Grove Path
pieces.note: A stone path runs through a towering bamboo grove toward the light, a rickshaw running down it and visitors strolling the other way as leaves drift through the green air.

pieces.name: Bamboo Raft Karsts
pieces.note: A fisherman in a conical hat poles a bamboo raft down a misty river at dawn, his lantern lit and a cormorant diving, between rank on rank of cone-shaped karst peaks.

pieces.name: Baobab Avenue Dusk
pieces.note: Giant bottle-shaped baobabs line a red dirt road at dusk against the glowing sky as an ox cart rolls past in its dust and bats leave the crowns.

pieces.name: Bar Chart Race
pieces.note: Ten city bars racing year by year, swapping places as their populations grow.

pieces.name: Basalt Column Coast
pieces.note: Thousands of hexagonal basalt columns step down like stairs into a stormy sea as waves break white over the lowest stones and a visitor climbs the steps.

pieces.name: Home Computer BASIC
pieces.note: An 8-bit home computer screen inside its thick border, where a short BASIC loop is typed at the READY prompt and run as a scrolling sine wave of stars.

pieces.name: Bats Leaving the Cave
pieces.note: At dusk a colony of bats pours from a cave in the cliff and streams into the orange sky in a long swirling ribbon.

pieces.name: Busy Bees
pieces.note: Bumblebees buzz from flower to flower over a sunny meadow, hovering at each bloom before zipping to the next.

pieces.name: Benchmark Results
pieces.note: A benchmark runner that measures each case with a live iteration counter and fills a table of timings compared to the last baseline.

pieces.name: Binary Search Steps
pieces.note: Binary search on a sorted array of twenty numbers, with lo, mid and hi pointers sliding into place, the discarded half greying out at every step and a log of each comparison until the target is found or proven missing.

pieces.name: Binary Star Orbit
pieces.note: A heavy orange star and a lighter blue companion swing around their shared centre of mass on Kepler ellipses, speeding up at closest approach and leaving fading trails.

pieces.name: Binary Search Tree
pieces.note: Values inserting into a binary search tree one by one, each comparison lighting the path down before the new node drops into place.

pieces.name: Firmware Setup Utility
pieces.note: A retro firmware setup screen where a cursor walks the tabs, enables a setting, reorders boot devices and saves.

pieces.name: Birthday Cake
pieces.note: A two-tier birthday cake with dripping frosting and sprinkles; its candles flicker, blow out in a puff of smoke and relight.

pieces.name: Bisect Hunt
pieces.note: A bisect session that tests the middle commit, marks it good or bad and halves the range until the first bad commit is found.

pieces.name: Black Hole
pieces.note: A black hole's accretion disk swirls around the dark shadow, its far side bent by gravity into a glowing halo.

pieces.name: Black Sand Falls
pieces.note: A tall waterfall pours off a mossy green cliff onto a black sand plain under a pale northern sky as a hiker in a red jacket walks toward the spray.

pieces.name: Blinking Cursor
pieces.note: A minimal prompt in big block type where a short word is typed and erased beside a blinking block cursor.

pieces.name: Block Drop
pieces.note: A falling-block puzzle that plays itself, sliding each piece into place and clearing full lines.

pieces.name: Blue Green Switch
pieces.note: A blue and green deployment where the idle environment boots the new release, passes its smoke tests, and the router flips every request across in one step while the old side drains and stands by.

pieces.name: Blue Mountain Town
pieces.note: A lane of blue-washed walls and stairs climbs through the mountain town past potted geraniums as a cat strolls down the steps and an awning sways.

pieces.name: Bohr Atom Photon
pieces.note: A hydrogen electron absorbs an ultraviolet photon and leaps from shell 1 to shell 3, then drops back in two steps, giving out a red 656 nm photon and an ultraviolet one, tracked on an energy level diagram.

pieces.name: Boids Over Meadow
pieces.note: A top-down boids flock steers by separation, alignment and cohesion, splitting and regrouping whenever a hunting hawk dives through.

pieces.name: Boiling Pasta Pot
pieces.note: A big steel pot at a rolling boil, spaghetti swirling as a wooden spoon stirs, bubbles bursting across the surface and steam pouring up.

pieces.name: Bonds Break And Form
pieces.note: Two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule absorb energy to break their bonds, the atoms regroup into two water molecules and more energy is released, traced on an energy profile.

pieces.name: Bonsai Tree
pieces.note: A twisted bonsai in a glazed blue pot, its cloud-shaped foliage pads rustling in a soft breeze.

pieces.name: Boombox Speaker Pump
pieces.note: A chrome boombox sits against a brick wall, its two speaker cones pumping on every kick while sound rings spread out and the tape reels turn.

pieces.name: Boot Sequence
pieces.note: A system boot log scrolls past with green OK tags, then the machine waits at a login prompt.

pieces.name: Borobudur Sunrise Mist
pieces.note: Bell-shaped stone stupas on the temple's top terrace face the sunrise as mist drifts through the jungle valley and a far volcano trails smoke.

pieces.name: Bosphorus Mosque Skyline
pieces.note: Istanbul's domes and slender minarets stand against a sunset over the Bosphorus, with ferries crossing the strait and gulls wheeling overhead.

pieces.name: Bouncing Balls
pieces.note: Six coloured balls fall under gravity, bounce off the floor and walls, lose energy with every hit and settle before the next drop.

pieces.name: Bouncing Letters
pieces.note: Block letters drop in one at a time, bounce with a little squash and settle on the floor before falling away.

pieces.name: Bouncy Green Slime
pieces.note: A glossy green slime blob hops along a dungeon floor, squashing flat on every landing and stretching tall as it leaps.

pieces.name: Latency Box Plots
pieces.note: Horizontal box plots of response time for six services, the boxes, medians, whiskers and outliers shifting as each new window of samples arrives.

pieces.name: Breaking News Ticker
pieces.note: A live news graphic where a red breaking banner slides in, each headline types itself into the lower third and a ticker crawls underneath.

pieces.name: Brian's Brain
pieces.note: The Brian's Brain cellular automaton: firing cells turn refractory then rest, so gliders and spreading wavefronts sweep endlessly across the grid.

pieces.name: Brick Breaker
pieces.note: A paddle that aims its own shots, chipping away at a rainbow wall of bricks until it is gone.

pieces.name: Wealth and Health Bubbles
pieces.note: A bubble chart of income against life expectancy for twelve regions, each bubble sized by population and drifting up and to the right decade by decade.

pieces.name: Bubble Tea Pearls
pieces.note: A tall cup of brown sugar milk tea, tapioca pearls sucked one by one up a fat pink straw while ice bobs and condensation runs down the cup.

pieces.name: Burger Stack Build
pieces.note: A burger builds itself on a wooden board, patty, melting cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion and a sesame bun dropping onto the stack one by one.

pieces.name: Burning Title
pieces.note: The word IGNITE glows like hot coals while turbulent flames curl up from every letter into the dark.

pieces.name: Butterfly
pieces.note: An orange and black butterfly flaps its patterned wings along a looping path above a flower garden.

pieces.name: Cake Icing Turntable
pieces.note: A layer cake turns on a cake stand as a steel spatula smooths pink icing around its side, then cream rosettes and berries appear along the top.

pieces.name: Calculator Keypad
pieces.note: A calculator where keys light up as they are pressed, the display builds an expression and the result rolls in on equals.

pieces.name: Calendar Month
pieces.note: A month calendar with coloured event dots, today marked, and a selection hopping between days with an agenda panel.

pieces.name: Twelve Month Heatmap
pieces.note: Twelve little month calendars fill in day by day with workout minutes, darker squares for rest days and bright ones for big sessions, until the whole year is logged.

pieces.name: Camel Caravan Dusk
pieces.note: A caravan of camels walks a desert dune crest against a low dusk sun, kicking up trails of dust.

pieces.name: Campfire Under Stars
pieces.note: A crackling campfire sends sparks up toward the milky way while a tent glows in its light.

pieces.name: Campfire
pieces.note: A campfire in a ring of stones, flames licking over crossed logs and sparks drifting up into the night.

pieces.name: Golden Canal Gondola
pieces.note: A narrow canal between old painted houses at golden hour, with a gondola gliding across, laundry swaying on the lines and ripples moving on the water.

pieces.name: Canary Rollout Gates
pieces.note: A canary release that moves traffic from 1 to 100 percent in steps while error rate and latency are compared against the stable build, promoting one release and automatically rolling back the next when its errors spike.

pieces.name: Candle Flame
pieces.note: A single candle in a dark room, its flame flickering and wax dripping slowly down the side.

pieces.name: Candlestick Chart
pieces.note: Green and red price candles with wicks scrolling left, the newest candle still forming against a live price line.

pieces.name: Cassette Tape Loading
pieces.note: An 8-bit computer loading from cassette, the border flashing pilot tone and data stripes while the loading screen picture paints in band by band.

pieces.name: Cassette Tape Reels
pieces.note: A handwritten mixtape plays in a deck, its reels turning as the tape winds across, then rewinding fast to the start.

pieces.name: Castle Bridge Dawn
pieces.note: An old stone bridge lined with statues crosses a misty river at dawn, with a gothic gate tower at one end and a hilltop castle against a pink sky.

pieces.name: Edge Cache Hit Miss
pieces.note: A CDN edge node where requests from three regions hit the cache and return fast, or miss and travel on to the origin, while every cached path counts down its TTL and expires.

pieces.name: Roadside Chai Dawn
pieces.note: At first light a chai vendor pours tea from a height while steam rises from the kettle, customers sip and a scooter putters past.

pieces.name: Chalkboard Lettering
pieces.note: A stick of chalk writes a big word on a dusty green board, underlines it, and a felt eraser wipes it away for the next one.

pieces.name: Chameleon and the Fly
pieces.note: A green chameleon grips a jungle branch, swivels its turret eye after a buzzing fly and catches it with one lightning flick of its tongue.

pieces.name: Charles Bridge Dawn
pieces.note: The old stone bridge with its row of statues and gothic gate tower at dawn, the castle on the hill beyond, mist on the river and the first walkers crossing.

pieces.name: Charminar Night Bazaar
pieces.note: The four-minaret gateway glows at night over the crowded bangle bazaar as shoppers flow through the street, stall lights flicker and autorickshaws weave past.

pieces.name: Chat Thread
pieces.note: A chat conversation where bubbles appear after a typing indicator and replies are typed in the composer.

pieces.name: Checkout Payment Flow
pieces.note: A checkout page fills shipping and card details, processes the payment and lands on a confirmed order.

pieces.name: Cherry Blossom River
pieces.note: A quiet river flows beneath rows of cherry blossom trees as pink petals drift down and float away.

pieces.name: Chess Replay
pieces.note: A short classic attacking game replayed move by move on a wooden board, ending in a queen sacrifice and mate.

pieces.name: Chichen Itza Equinox
pieces.note: The stepped pyramid at Chichen Itza at golden hour on the equinox, the serpent of light forming down its stair while visitors cross the lawn and birds fly home.

pieces.name: Chiptune Tracker
pieces.note: A four channel music tracker plays a chiptune, note rows scrolling up past the play line while the meters jump, the channel scopes wiggle and the pattern counter steps.

pieces.name: Chladni Figures
pieces.note: Sand on a vibrating metal plate jumps off the moving regions and settles on the still nodal lines, redrawing a new figure each time the frequency changes.

pieces.name: Chocolate Fountain
pieces.note: Sheets of melted chocolate cascade down a three tier steel fountain into a swirling basin while a strawberry on a skewer is dipped in and pulled out coated.

pieces.name: Christmas Tree
pieces.note: A decorated fir tree with twinkling coloured lights, gold garlands and a shining star, presents waiting in the snow.

pieces.name: CI Pipeline
pieces.note: A CI pipeline where each run moves through checkout, install, lint, test, build and deploy, with spinners, timings, a live log and the odd failing test.

pieces.name: Silent Film Title Card
pieces.note: An old projector reel counts down 3 2 1 with a sweeping leader, then lands on a framed THE END card full of grain, scratches and gate weave.

pieces.name: Circuit Breaker States
pieces.note: A circuit breaker that counts failures from a struggling downstream service, trips open to fail fast, waits out a cooldown, sends a trial call while half open and closes again once the service recovers.

pieces.name: Circuit Lap Racer
pieces.note: Four cars race lap after lap around a top-down circuit, braking into the corners and trading places while the standings update.

pieces.name: Circuit Trace
pieces.note: A strip of circuit board traces with copper pads and vias, green and blue signals racing along them.

pieces.name: Cliff Lighthouse Night
pieces.note: A lighthouse on a sea cliff turns its beam across a starry night while a ship passes on the horizon and clouds drift by.

pieces.name: Whitewashed Cliff Village
pieces.note: A whitewashed village with blue domes spills down a volcanic cliff above a deep blue sea, with a windmill turning, boats crossing and gulls overhead.

pieces.name: Clifford Attractor
pieces.note: A Clifford strange attractor drawn as a glowing density map, its four parameters drifting so the silky folds keep reshaping themselves.

pieces.name: Clockwork Gears
pieces.note: A train of brass, copper and steel gears meshing tooth to gap and turning at their true ratios.

pieces.name: Waving Flag
pieces.note: A flag ripples on its pole in a gusty wind, travelling waves rolling along the cloth with light and shade in every fold.

pieces.name: Cloud Drift
pieces.note: Puffy white clouds drift in slow layers across a deep blue summer sky above distant hills.

pieces.name: Rolling Deployment
pieces.note: A cluster rolling update where new pods start, pass readiness and replace old ones while a status line counts up to a successful rollout.

pieces.name: Cocktail Shaker Pour
pieces.note: A frosted steel shaker rattles hard, tips over and pours a coral cocktail into a coupe glass, then a lime wheel lands on the rim.

pieces.name: Code Editor
pieces.note: An editor window with line numbers where a small rate limiter is typed out in syntax colours.

pieces.name: Coffee Mug
pieces.note: A red mug of coffee on a wooden table, wisps of steam curling up into the warm room.

pieces.name: Coin Run Platformer
pieces.note: A side-scrolling hero runs on its own through grassy hills, jumping pits, landing on brick ledges, stomping critters and collecting coins.

pieces.name: Space Colonisation Tree
pieces.note: A tree grows by the space colonisation algorithm, each branch reaching toward a cloud of attractor points that vanish as they are claimed, then bursts into leaf.

pieces.name: Color Picker Sliders
pieces.note: A colour picker where the hue strip, the shade field and the RGB sliders move together and the swatch and hex code follow.

pieces.name: Colosseum Golden Hour
pieces.note: The great arched amphitheatre glows gold in the low evening sun as scooters buzz past on the road and a flock of birds wheels overhead.

pieces.name: Comet Crossing
pieces.note: A bright comet glides across a starry sky above dark hills, its curved dust tail and straight blue ion tail streaming behind.

pieces.name: Command Palette
pieces.note: A command palette drops over a dimmed editor, filters commands as a query is typed and runs the pick.

pieces.name: Compiler Warnings
pieces.note: A compiler build log that compiles dependencies, prints an unused variable warning with a pointed snippet and finishes green.

pieces.name: School Computer Lab
pieces.note: A school computer lab with three beige terminals on a long desk, one listing a BASIC program in green, one compiling in amber and one playing a bat and ball game, under a ticking wall clock.

pieces.name: Concert Stage Crowd
pieces.note: A band plays on a hazy stage as moving head beams sweep and change colour, the screen behind pulses and the crowd jumps with hands in the air.

pieces.name: Conductor Baton Beats
pieces.note: A conductor seen from behind leads an orchestra, the baton tip tracing four and three beat patterns with a golden trail and each beat number lighting up.

pieces.name: Consistent Hash Ring
pieces.note: A consistent hashing ring where each key belongs to the next node clockwise, and when a node joins or fails only the keys in its arc move, shown as they change owner.

pieces.name: Constellation Lettering
pieces.note: On a drifting star chart, bright stars light up and are joined line by line until the constellation spells a word, then it fades into the next.

pieces.name: Contributors Wall
pieces.note: Tiny pixel avatars pop onto a wall one by one, every face different, until the contributor count lands and a thank-you appears.

pieces.name: Sun in Sunglasses
pieces.note: A grinning sun in dark sunglasses bobs over the beach as its rays turn, now and then sliding the shades down its nose to give you a wink.

pieces.name: Copper Bar Demo
pieces.note: A demoscene intro with glowing copper bars swinging past each other, a rainbow logo wobbling line by line, parallax stars and a big sine wave scroller.

pieces.name: Magnetic Core Plane
pieces.note: A magnetic core memory plane where an X and a Y select wire light up together and the ferrite core where they cross flips, bit by bit storing a heart and a smile before the rows are cleared.

pieces.name: Cotton Candy Spinner
pieces.note: Pink sugar threads whirl around a carnival spinner tub while a paper cone turns and gathers a growing cloud of cotton candy.

pieces.name: Countdown Timer
pieces.note: Big digits count down from ten inside a ring that drains every second, then GO bursts out in green.

pieces.name: Coverage Report
pieces.note: A code coverage report where per-file bars fill up, colour by threshold and then re-sort so the weakest files rise to the top.

pieces.name: CPU Monitor
pieces.note: A terminal system monitor with eight per-core usage bars, memory and swap, load averages and a busy process list.

pieces.name: Crate Pusher Puzzle
pieces.note: A tiny warehouse worker solves box-pushing puzzles on its own, shoving every crate onto a marked spot before moving to the next level.

pieces.name: CRT Test Card
pieces.note: An old CRT television showing a colour test card, the picture rolling slowly with visible scanlines.

pieces.name: Crystal Grain Growth
pieces.note: Crystals nucleate one by one in a cooling melt and grow outward until they lock together into a mosaic of grains, each with its own lattice angle.

pieces.name: Cuckoo Clock
pieces.note: A carved wooden cuckoo clock ticks on a warm wall, pendulum swinging and pinecone weights on their chains, and the little bird pops out to call on the hour.

pieces.name: Neon Alley
pieces.note: A rainy night alley runs toward a glowing street, its neon signs buzzing and pooling in the wet ground.

pieces.name: Cylinder
pieces.note: A striped cylinder tumbling slowly in space, its curved side and flat caps lit and depth-sorted.

pieces.name: Dancing Pot Cactus
pieces.note: A potted cactus with a pink flower on its head sways its hips and swings its arms to a beat against a desert sunset.

pieces.name: ETL Data Flow
pieces.note: An ETL pipeline where raw records leave three sources, pass through clean, dedupe and join steps, and land in a warehouse as counters climb.

pieces.name: Data Table
pieces.note: A service status table that re-sorts by a new column every few seconds while a selection bar walks the rows.

pieces.name: Date Range Picker
pieces.note: A two month calendar where a start date is clicked, the range stretches with the cursor and the night count updates.

pieces.name: Primary Replica Sync
pieces.note: Database replication where every write is appended to the primary's log and streamed to three replicas, one cross-region with visible lag and one that loses its link and then catches up in a burst.

pieces.name: Rubber Duck Debugger
pieces.note: A yellow rubber duck bobs on rippling water, listening patiently to your bug and thinking out loud in a speech bubble until it is fixed.

pieces.name: Bug With a Magnifier
pieces.note: A little red beetle paces along a page of code holding up a magnifying glass, stopping to peer at the line with the error underlined in red.

pieces.name: Decode Reveal
pieces.note: A field of cipher noise gives way column by column as a block letter phrase decrypts out of it.

pieces.name: Delivery Route Tracker
pieces.note: A delivery tracking screen where the route draws across a street grid, the courier moves along it and the order steps tick to delivered.

pieces.name: Departures Hall Board
pieces.note: A full airport departures board with times, flights, destinations, gates and statuses that flip as boarding opens, gates close and flights leave the list.

pieces.name: Desert Buttes Road
pieces.note: A straight road runs toward giant red sandstone buttes across the desert as a red car drives it trailing dust, cloud shadows sliding over the land.

pieces.name: Desert Camp Milky Way
pieces.note: The Milky Way arches over a desert camp among moonlit dunes, tents glowing warm and a campfire throwing sparks as a figure with a lantern walks between them.

pieces.name: Desert Dunes
pieces.note: Rolling sand dunes bake under a blazing sky while the wind lifts sand off every crest.

pieces.name: Thar Fort Caravan
pieces.note: A camel train plods across the dunes below a golden sandstone hill fort with round bastions and domed pavilions as the desert sun sets.

pieces.name: Desert Needle Skyline
pieces.note: A needle thin supertall tower rises over a glittering desert city at night, with lit windows changing, cars streaming along the highway and a full moon above the dunes.

pieces.name: Desert Oasis Palms
pieces.note: Date palms ring a turquoise pool deep in the golden dunes as a traveller leads camels down to the water and the wind lifts sand off the crests.

pieces.name: Desk Fan
pieces.note: An electric desk fan with spinning blades behind a wire guard, its head slowly sweeping left and right.

pieces.name: Baraat Dhol Night
pieces.note: A wedding procession at night: a dhol player drums and dances while the groom rides a white horse past lamp bearers, dancers and falling petals.

pieces.name: Dial-Up Handshake
pieces.note: A retro terminal program that dials out, shows the modem handshake as a noisy signal with front panel lights, connects and lands on a bulletin board.

pieces.name: Digital Clock
pieces.note: A big seven segment clock ticking through the seconds, with ghosted unlit segments and a blinking colon.

pieces.name: Dijkstra Shortest Path
pieces.note: Dijkstra's algorithm on a weighted graph, popping the closest node from the priority queue, relaxing each edge and updating distances, then lighting the shortest route from A to O.

pieces.name: Desert Runner
pieces.note: A runner sprints across the desert at ever faster speed, jumping cacti until a mistimed leap ends the run.

pieces.name: Partition Editor
pieces.note: A curses-style partition editor that carves a new partition out of free space, writes the table and formats it.

pieces.name: Diwali Diyas
pieces.note: A row of clay oil lamps flickering on a ledge above a slowly turning rangoli, under a marigold garland.

pieces.name: DJ Decks Crossfader
pieces.note: Two turntables spin either side of a mixer while the crossfader slides from one deck to the other and both waveforms scroll past the playhead.

pieces.name: Diffusion Aggregation
pieces.note: Random walkers drift in from the dark and stick on contact, building a branching frost-like cluster one particle at a time.

pieces.name: DNA Replication Fork
pieces.note: Helicase unzips the double helix, the leading strand is copied in one smooth run and the lagging strand in short Okazaki fragments that are primed, filled and sealed, base letters and all.

pieces.name: DNS Lookup Path
pieces.note: A DNS lookup where the resolver asks the root, then the TLD, then the authoritative server, caches each referral and answers the repeat query in two milliseconds.

pieces.name: DNS Resolver Chain
pieces.note: A DNS lookup diagram where a query packet hops from the client to the resolver, root, TLD and authoritative servers and the answer returns.

pieces.name: Donut Chart
pieces.note: A ring chart filling clockwise to its target with the percentage counting up in the middle.

pieces.name: Doppler Effect Siren

pieces.name: Dosa On The Tawa

pieces.name: Dot Matrix Banner
pieces.note: A dot matrix printer prints a giant sideways banner on continuous tractor-feed paper, the head racing back and forth as the perforated sheet feeds up and away.

pieces.name: Pulsing Dot Rule
pieces.note: A quiet rule of dots where soft pulses of light swell and travel from end to end.

pieces.name: Double Helix
pieces.note: Two glossy strands twisting around each other like DNA, joined by coloured base pairs and depth-sorted as they turn.

pieces.name: Double Line Frame
pieces.note: A double-line box frame with an inner rule, while comets of gold and blue light chase each other round it.

pieces.name: Double Pendulum
pieces.note: A double pendulum swings chaotically under gravity, its lower bob tracing a fading trail that never settles into a pattern.

pieces.name: Doughnut Glazing Line
pieces.note: Plain ring doughnuts ride a bakery conveyor under a falling curtain of pink glaze and roll out shiny, dripping and covered in sprinkles.

pieces.name: Download Queue
pieces.note: A download manager where six files report size, speed and time left, then finish one by one.

pieces.name: Dragon Curve
pieces.note: A line folded in half over and over, each fold swinging out a new copy until the Heighway dragon appears.

pieces.name: Drum Machine Sequencer
pieces.note: A 16 step drum machine plays its pattern, the playhead sweeping across lit pads as kick, snare, hats and claps fire, with a fill every fourth bar.

pieces.name: Rotating Earth
pieces.note: The earth turns on its tilted axis, continents and clouds sliding from daylight across the terminator into city-lit night.

pieces.name: East River Bridge Sunrise
pieces.note: A suspension bridge with gothic stone towers spans the river at sunrise in front of a hazy skyline, with traffic crossing, a tugboat pushing upstream and gulls overhead.

pieces.name: Easter Eggs
pieces.note: Five painted eggs with dots, zigzags and stripes wobble in turn in spring grass beneath drifting clouds.

pieces.name: Solar Eclipse
pieces.note: The moon slides across the sun as the sky darkens, and at totality the pale corona flares out around the black disc.

pieces.name: Eid Crescent
pieces.note: A slim new crescent and twinkling stars rise over a skyline of domes and minarets with warmly lit windows.

pieces.name: Elephants At Waterhole
pieces.note: Elephants gather at a waterhole on the golden savanna, one drinking and one spraying water over its back, as the rest of the herd walks past under the flat-topped acacias.

pieces.name: Ellora Rock Temple
pieces.note: A whole temple carved down out of a single basalt hillside stands in its pit, tower, hall, pillars and stone elephant all one rock, as visitors walk the court and a monkey runs the cliff ledge.

pieces.name: Access Denied Padlock
pieces.note: A brass padlock's shackle drops and snaps shut with a small jolt above a polite request access button.

pieces.name: All Caught Up Check
pieces.note: A green ring and checkmark draw themselves stroke by stroke, pop a little burst and rewind.

pieces.name: Broken Link Cloud
pieces.note: A cloud drifts above a chain link that has snapped in two, the halves swinging apart as chips fall from the break.

pieces.name: Copied To Clipboard
pieces.note: A pointer clicks copy on an invite link, the lines paste onto a clipboard and a small copied pill pops up.

pieces.name: Saved To Cloud Tick
pieces.note: An arrow rises into a soft cloud, a tick is cut into the cloud and a last saved timer starts counting.

pieces.name: Cobweb Empty Folder
pieces.note: An empty open folder sits under a corner cobweb while a small spider bobs up and down on its thread.

pieces.name: Construction Crane Panel
pieces.note: A tower crane trolleys bricks one at a time from a pile onto a growing wall, an under construction state.

pieces.name: Empty Inbox Plane
pieces.note: A paper plane loops a figure eight above an empty inbox tray, trailing a dotted line.

pieces.name: No Search Results
pieces.note: A magnifying glass sweeps over empty result rows beneath a search box that came up with nothing.

pieces.name: Unplugged Offline Cable
pieces.note: An unplugged cable sways beside its wall socket and throws the odd spark while a retry timer counts down.

pieces.name: Onboarding Flag Planted
pieces.note: Checkpoints tick off one by one up a hill path, then a flag drops onto the summit, kicks up dust and waves.

pieces.name: Payment Declined Shake
pieces.note: A bank card tries to pay, the charge is declined, the card gives a gentle shake and a red cross appears.

pieces.name: Payment Success Card
pieces.note: A bank card slides in, a spinner processes the charge, then a green tick pops and the amount counts up.

pieces.name: Rate Limit Hourglass
pieces.note: An hourglass drains grain by grain as a try again in 30 seconds countdown ticks down, then the retry button wakes up.

pieces.name: Reconnecting Signal Bars
pieces.note: Signal bars climb on each reconnect attempt, drop when it fails, and all turn green when the connection is back.

pieces.name: Coming Soon Rocket
pieces.note: A small rocket vents steam on its pad through a ten second countdown, then lifts off on a column of flame.

pieces.name: Session Expired Clock
pieces.note: A sleepy wall clock sweeps its hands while little z's drift up from it, above a sign in again button.

pieces.name: Smoking Server Box
pieces.note: A small server box with a dizzy face puffs smoke from its vent, a friendly something went wrong state.

pieces.name: Task Done Confetti
pieces.note: A three item checklist ticks itself off and a burst of confetti rains down around the card.

pieces.name: Trash Lid Closing
pieces.note: A crumpled page arcs into a bin, the lid swings shut with a bump and an undo timer drains away.

pieces.name: Upload Into Tray
pieces.note: A big arrow drops into a file tray while the progress bar fills, then the tray bounces and a tick pops up.

pieces.name: Welcome Door Opening
pieces.note: A front door swings open and warm light spills out across the floor, a friendly first run welcome.

pieces.name: End Credits Roll
pieces.note: Film end credits roll up a letterboxed screen, roles right-aligned against a centre gutter, names beside them and section headings in between.

pieces.name: Endless Corridor
pieces.note: A ray-cast flight down an infinite corridor, ceiling lamps, red doors and a glowing trim line rushing past.

pieces.name: Food Chain Energy Pyramid
pieces.note: Sunlight feeds the plants at the base of an energy pyramid and only about a tenth of the energy climbs to each level above, the rest drifting off as heat, with the kilojoules counted.

pieces.name: ER Diagram
pieces.note: An entity relationship diagram of a shop database where each foreign key link lights up in turn with its join written below.

pieces.name: Espresso Machine Pour
pieces.note: A chrome espresso machine pulls a double shot into a glass cup, twin streams pouring, crema rising, the pressure gauge climbing and steam drifting from the wand.

pieces.name: Extruded Word Spin
pieces.note: A chunky 3D extruded word swings back and forth in space with a lit pink face and deep blue sides.

pieces.name: Fairy Chimney Balloons
pieces.note: Dozens of hot air balloons drift over a valley of capped rock chimneys and carved cave homes as the sun comes up behind the far tablelands.

pieces.name: Falling Leaves
pieces.note: Autumn leaves tumble and drift down from a golden tree in a warm haze onto a carpet of fallen leaves.

pieces.name: Falling Sand
pieces.note: Three moving spouts pour coloured sand that tumbles and piles into striped dunes, then a trapdoor opens and the box drains to start again.

pieces.name: Fern Fractal
pieces.note: Self-similar fern fronds unroll from tight fiddleheads on the forest floor, leaflet by leaflet, and sway in the damp air.

pieces.name: Ferris Wheel
pieces.note: A big wheel turning against a dusk sky, its rim lights chasing and its gondolas hanging level.

pieces.name: Festival Speaker Stack
pieces.note: A towering festival sound system at night, its big sub cones pumping on every kick beside a hanging line array while lasers rake over the crowd and confetti falls.

pieces.name: File Tree
pieces.note: A project explorer where a cursor walks the tree, opening and closing folders as it goes.

pieces.name: Film Projector
pieces.note: A reel-to-reel film projector whirs in a dark room, reels turning and dust drifting through its beam as a countdown leader plays on the screen.

pieces.name: Firefly Meadow
pieces.note: Fireflies drift and blink over a dusk meadow beneath a dark treeline and a fading sunset.

pieces.name: Fireworks
pieces.note: Rockets climbing over a night city skyline and bursting into coloured, falling shells.

pieces.name: Fjord Ferry Passage
pieces.note: A ferry sails up a deep fjord between plunging cliff walls as ribbon waterfalls pour down them and a red farmhouse clings to a green ledge high above.

pieces.name: Profiler Flame Graph
pieces.note: A CPU profiler flame graph whose stacks grow and settle as samples come in while a cursor inspects the hottest frames.

pieces.name: Flip Dot Board
pieces.note: A mechanical flip dot board whose yellow discs turn over in a sweeping wave each time it changes to the next word.

pieces.name: Floating Islands
pieces.note: Grassy islands drift above a sea of cloud, waterfalls pouring off their edges into the mist below.

pieces.name: Murmuration
pieces.note: Hundreds of starlings fold and stretch as one across a sunset sky over a still lake, while a few birds flap past close by.

pieces.name: Floppy Disk Copier
pieces.note: A disk copy utility reads a floppy track by track, the head stepping across the spinning disk while a sector map fills in and the drive light glows.

pieces.name: Flow Field
pieces.note: Hundreds of particles tracing streamlines through a noise flow field, coloured by the direction they travel.

pieces.name: Flowchart
pieces.note: An order flowchart of boxes and a decision diamond, with a token travelling the arrows, looping back on an error and logging each step.

pieces.name: Rising Smoke
pieces.note: A thin ribbon of smoke rises from a glowing incense tip, stays smooth for a moment, then breaks into curling turbulent eddies.

pieces.name: Form Validation Errors
pieces.note: A form is submitted half filled, red errors drop in under each bad field, then each one is corrected until it submits clean.

pieces.name: Terminal Fortune Cookie
pieces.note: A shell command cracks open a fortune cookie in the terminal, a paper slip slides out with an original fortune and lucky numbers, then the screen clears for another.

pieces.name: Friendly Floating Ghost
pieces.note: A round little ghost bobs above a misty graveyard, waving its stubby arms, rippling its hem and blinking shyly.

pieces.name: Frog Hop Crossing
pieces.note: A self-playing frog hops between speeding cars and rides logs and turtles across the river to fill its five lily pad homes.

pieces.name: Front Panel Toggle Programming
pieces.note: A minicomputer front panel where an operator flips the toggle switches to enter a short program word by word, deposits each one, then hits run and the data lights chase.

pieces.name: Fruit Bowl Apple Roll
pieces.note: A heaped blue fruit bowl of oranges, bananas, grapes and a pear on a sunny table; an apple is set on top, wobbles, tumbles off and rolls away.

pieces.name: Fuji Dawn Lake
pieces.note: A snow capped volcano glows pink at dawn over a mirror lake, with cranes flying past and a small boat poling across.

pieces.name: Signup Funnel
pieces.note: A signup funnel counting up through the day, dots dropping in at the top and thinning out stage by stage from visits down to paid customers.

pieces.name: Game of Life
pieces.note: Conway's Game of Life on a wrapping board, cells coloured by age, starting a fresh random board every 45 seconds, or sooner if it stalls.

pieces.name: Ganesh Utsav Procession
pieces.note: A Ganesh idol rides a flower-decked cart through the evening streets as dhol players drum in front, the crowd raises its hands and petals and pink gulal drift by.

pieces.name: Ganges Dawn
pieces.note: Dawn breaks over riverside ghats as wooden boats drift past and floating lamps flicker on the water.

pieces.name: Gantt Chart
pieces.note: A project Gantt chart where the today marker sweeps across the weeks, task bars fill with progress and milestones light up.

pieces.name: Server Gauge Cluster
pieces.note: A server dashboard of four arc gauges for CPU, memory, disk and network, the needles swinging to live readings with sparklines of the last minute underneath.

pieces.name: Gem Cascade
pieces.note: A match-three board that plays itself, swapping gems into lines, clearing them in bursts and letting new gems cascade down into combos.

pieces.name: Ghat Evening Aarti
pieces.note: Priests swing brass lamps in slow circles on the river steps at dusk while boats of onlookers drift and leaf lamps float downstream.

pieces.name: Giraffes Below The Peak
pieces.note: Giraffes browse the flat-topped acacias on the golden savanna below the snow-capped volcano at sunrise as a band of cloud drifts across its flanks.

pieces.name: Git Branch Graph
pieces.note: A commit graph drawing itself over time as feature branches split from main, gain commits and merge back, with the latest commit message below.

pieces.name: Git Log Graph
pieces.note: A git log graph with feature branches merging back into main as new commits land on top.

pieces.name: Giza Pyramids Sunset
pieces.note: The three pyramids of Giza glow on their sunlit faces as the sun sets, while a camel caravan with riders walks along the dunes in front.

pieces.name: Glacier Calving Front
pieces.note: The towering blue-white front of a glacier meets the lake, and every so often a slab of ice breaks away and crashes in with a great splash as bergs drift and a tour boat watches.

pieces.name: Glacier Lagoon Ice
pieces.note: Icebergs of white and glacial blue, some striped with ash, drift across a still lagoon under the pastel midnight sun as a seal rolls through the water and terns fly over.

pieces.name: Glitch Title Settle
pieces.note: A big title tears into sliding slices, splits into red and cyan channels and corrupted blocks, then settles into a crisp clean word.

pieces.name: Goa Shack Sunset
pieces.note: Waves roll up the sand below swaying coconut palms as the sun sets behind a fishing boat and the beach shack lights its lamps.

pieces.name: Daily Goal Rings
pieces.note: Four daily goal rings for steps, water, focus time and sleep filling up as the day goes on, each one closing with a check mark when its goal is met.

pieces.name: Bridge in the Fog
pieces.note: A red suspension bridge stands over the bay as thick fog rolls in beneath its deck.

pieces.name: Golden Pavilion Pond
pieces.note: The gold-leaf pavilion stands mirrored in its pond among pines and autumn maples while two ducks paddle across and clouds drift over the hills.

pieces.name: Golden Shrine Pool
pieces.note: A floodlit golden shrine glows on its sacred pool at night as pilgrims cross the marble causeway and ripples run through its reflection.

pieces.name: Goldfish Tank
pieces.note: Goldfish glide back and forth through a planted aquarium while bubbles stream up from the air stone.

pieces.name: Gradient Descent Contours
pieces.note: Two optimisers walk down a contour map of a stretched loss bowl, plain gradient descent zigzagging across the valley while momentum curves smoothly to the minimum, with their loss curves drawn alongside.

pieces.name: Grand Canyon Rim
pieces.note: Ridge after ridge of banded red rock fades into the sunset from the canyon rim, the river a thin thread far below as ravens ride the updraft past a gnarled juniper.

pieces.name: Granite Towers Lake
pieces.note: Three sheer granite towers glow orange at sunrise over a milky turquoise glacial lake as cloud streams off their summits and guanacos walk the windswept shore.

pieces.name: Granite Valley Falls
pieces.note: A ribbon waterfall leaps from the rim of a glacier-carved granite valley as the great half-dome glows orange in the evening light above the pines and the meadow river.

pieces.name: Graphic EQ Peak Hold
pieces.note: A rack mounted graphic equaliser whose LED bars jump to a kick, snare and hats while peak hold markers hang at the top and drift back down.

pieces.name: Great Wall Sunset
pieces.note: The Great Wall winds over layered blue ridges as the sun sets, with drifting cloud, rising mist and birds.

pieces.name: Green Screen Word Processor
pieces.note: A green phosphor word processor where a letter is typed and wraps at the margin, typos are backspaced, a paragraph is marked as a block and the file is saved.

pieces.name: Group Chat Transcript
pieces.note: A three-person group chat plans a weekend hike, bubbles stacking up with avatars, names, reactions and read receipts while the feed scrolls.

pieces.name: Growing Tree
pieces.note: A seed sprouts and grows into a branching tree, leafs out, turns gold, drops its leaves and starts again.

pieces.name: Guitar Fretting Hand
pieces.note: A hand moves between chord shapes on an acoustic guitar neck while a pick strums and the strings blur as they vibrate.

pieces.name: Gully Cricket Over
pieces.note: A gully cricket over in a narrow lane of painted houses: the bowler runs in, the batter lofts it over the rooftops and the fielder throws up his arms.

pieces.name: Gimbal Gyroscope
pieces.note: A gyroscope of three nested gold, steel and copper rings, each turning on its own pivot around a fast spinning rotor disc.

pieces.name: Jack O Lantern
pieces.note: A carved pumpkin flickers on a hill beneath a huge moon while bats flap across a purple night sky.

pieces.name: Hampi Boulder Ruins
pieces.note: An old temple tower rises among hills of giant piled boulders at golden hour as a round coracle spins down the river past banana groves and a langur watches from the rocks.

pieces.name: Harbour Gateway Mumbai
pieces.note: The basalt triumphal arch stands on the waterfront at sunset beside the grand hotel's red domes as ferry launches bob in the harbour and pigeons wheel over the plaza.

pieces.name: Neon Harbour Ferry
pieces.note: A neon city skyline over a night harbour under a full moon, with office windows switching on and off, a ferry crossing and cars streaming over the bridge.

pieces.name: Harbour Sails Opera
pieces.note: An opera house of white shell roofs sits on its point in a wide harbour at sunset, with a steel arch bridge behind and green ferries crossing with their wakes.

pieces.name: Havana Pastel Cruisers

pieces.name: Hawa Mahal Morning
pieces.note: A pink palace facade of countless small latticed windows catches the morning sun as pigeons wheel past.

pieces.name: Headphones Sound Waves

pieces.name: Heap Allocator Map

pieces.name: Heart 3D

pieces.name: Heart Blood Flow

pieces.name: Heartbeat Rule
pieces.note: A green ECG heartbeat trace swept across the page like a bedside monitor, with a heart that beats on every spike.

pieces.name: Contribution Heatmap
pieces.note: A year of daily activity filling in square by square, from quiet grey to bright green, with a running total.

pieces.name: Hilbert Curve
pieces.note: A fifth-order Hilbert curve drawing itself corner by corner in a rainbow, then reeling back in.

pieces.name: Hill Train Kanchenjunga
pieces.note: The little blue steam train climbs its winding track through tea gardens below the snow giant glowing pink at dawn, puffing smoke as mist fills the valley.

pieces.name: Himalaya Peaks
pieces.note: Sharp snow peaks rise above drifting cloud while strings of prayer flags flutter in the wind.

pieces.name: Himalayan Flower Valley
pieces.note: A high alpine meadow thick with pink, yellow, blue and white wildflowers runs down from the snow peaks, a glacier stream winding through it as trekkers climb the trail and butterflies flutter.

pieces.name: Histogram

pieces.name: Holi Colours
pieces.note: Clouds of pink, yellow, green, blue, orange and violet powder burst and drift over a dancing crowd in white.

pieces.name: Holographic Grid Sphere

pieces.name: Hourglass

pieces.name: Houseboat Backwater Dusk

pieces.name: Howrah Bridge Dawn
pieces.note: Buses and yellow taxis cross the great steel cantilever bridge in a hazy dawn as country boats and a ferry work the river below and bathers walk down the ghat.

pieces.name: Hummingbird at Hibiscus
pieces.note: A ruby-throated hummingbird hovers on blurred wings, sipping from one red hibiscus and then darting across to the other.

pieces.name: Hyperspace Jump
pieces.note: Calm stars stretch into streaks, the ship plunges into a swirling blue hyperspace tunnel and then drops back out among the stars.

pieces.name: Shattering Ice Letters

pieces.name: Icosahedron
pieces.note: A twenty-faced solid turning on two axes, every triangular facet lit flat in shades of teal.

pieces.name: Debugger Stepping

pieces.name: Bright Idea Bulb
pieces.note: A light bulb ponders in the dark with its eyes rolled up, flickers a few times, then switches on with a bright idea and a delighted grin.

pieces.name: Container Layer Pull

pieces.name: Imperial Palace Snow

pieces.name: Inbox List
pieces.note: An email inbox with unread dots, stars and previews, where new mail slides in at the top.

pieces.name: India Gate Evening
pieces.note: The great memorial arch glows at dusk as its lamps come on, families stroll the long avenue and balloon sellers' bunches bob over the lawns.

pieces.name: Infra Plan and Apply

pieces.name: Ink in Water

pieces.name: Install Log
pieces.note: A package manager install log resolving, fetching and linking packages, ending in a green summary.

pieces.name: Island Abbey Tide
pieces.note: The abbey crowns its rocky tidal island at sunset, mirrored in the wet sand as the tide creeps in and out and pilgrims walk the causeway.

pieces.name: Island Church Lake

pieces.name: Julia Set

pieces.name: Jungle Temple Mist

pieces.name: Karaoke Lyrics

pieces.name: Klein Bottle

pieces.name: Koi Pond Ripples

pieces.name: Kolkata Tram Morning

pieces.name: Pagoda Lantern Lane
pieces.note: A sloping old street of wooden houses and red lanterns leads up to a five storey pagoda at dusk, with people under umbrellas walking through light rain.

pieces.name: L-System Plant

pieces.name: Lagoon Overwater Huts

pieces.name: Laser Engraved Plate

pieces.name: Lattu Spinning Top

pieces.name: Leaderboard

pieces.name: Lemonade Stand Pour

pieces.name: Harbor Liberty Dawn

pieces.name: Lighthouse Lamp Room

pieces.name: Lighthouse Storm
