pieces.name: River Lantern Festival
pieces.note: Paper lanterns rise slowly into the night from a crowded arched bridge, glowing over the river and the lit town beyond.

pieces.name: Riverfront Tower Night
pieces.note: The skyline across the river at night, the pearl tower's spheres glowing among the glass giants, their lights streaking down the water as a ferry crosses.

pieces.name: Drone Sign Crew
pieces.note: A crew of tiny drones ferries blocks from a depot to build a big OPEN sign on a blueprint, then carries it all back.

pieces.name: Waving Tin Robot
pieces.note: A friendly tin robot waves hello with one arm, blinks its round screen eyes and flashes the light on its antenna.

pieces.name: Rock Blaster
pieces.note: A small arrow ship in deep space turns, thrusts and fires on its own, splitting tumbling space rocks into smaller and smaller pieces.

pieces.name: Rock Cycle Loop
pieces.note: A rock grain travels the rock cycle: magma cools into igneous rock, weathers into sediment, is pressed into sedimentary rock, squeezed into metamorphic rock and melts again.

pieces.name: Rocket Launch
pieces.note: A rocket ignites on the pad at dusk and climbs away on a column of flame, leaving a billowing cloud behind.

pieces.name: Rooftop Kite Sunset
pieces.note: On the winter kite festival, people on crowded city rooftops tug their strings as bright paper kites swoop across the sunset.

pieces.name: Rope Bridge Crossing
pieces.note: A hiker crosses a plank rope bridge over a canyon at dusk, the Verlet simulated deck sagging and bouncing under every step.

pieces.name: Twisted Rope
pieces.note: A thick twisted rope laid across the page, its strands rolling along as it slowly turns.

pieces.name: Rotary Phone
pieces.note: A red desk telephone whose finger wheel turns to the stop and springs back as a number is dialled.

pieces.name: Rotating Cube
pieces.note: A solid cube tumbling on two axes, each face lit flat with a character ramp and crisp bright edges.

pieces.name: Dodecahedron
pieces.note: A solid dodecahedron tumbling on three axes, its twelve pentagon faces lit in blue, amber and green with crisp edges.

pieces.name: Rotating Star
pieces.note: A thick five-pointed gold star extruded in 3D, spinning on its axis and catching the light on its bevels.

pieces.name: Rotozoomer
pieces.note: The demoscene rotozoomer, a checkered XOR texture spinning and zooming in and out.

pieces.name: Rover on Red Dunes
pieces.note: A six-wheeled rover rolls across rippled red dunes, wheels turning and mast camera scanning, leaving twin tracks and a trail of dust under a butterscotch sky.

pieces.name: Rule 30
pieces.note: The rule 30 elementary cellular automaton growing from a single cell, its chaotic triangles scrolling upward.

pieces.name: Salt Flat Mirror
pieces.note: A vast salt flat under a thin sheet of water mirrors the sunset sky perfectly, clouds above and below, as a jeep crosses the horizon and walkers stride out on the reflection.

pieces.name: Sand Crab Scuttle
pieces.note: A red crab scuttles sideways across a sunny beach, claws raised, darting up the sand whenever a wave washes in.

pieces.name: Budget Sankey Flow
pieces.note: A monthly budget as a sankey diagram, three income streams pouring through curved ribbons into five spending categories, with money flowing along each band.

pieces.name: Santorini Blue Domes
pieces.note: White houses and blue domes step down the cliff over the caldera at sunset while a sailboat crosses the sea and a cat strolls along a wall.

pieces.name: Satellite Orbit
pieces.note: A satellite with glinting solar panel wings circles a cloudy blue planet, slipping behind it and back into the light.

pieces.name: Savanna Sunset
pieces.note: Acacia trees stand black against a huge orange sun while giraffes and elephants walk across the plain.

pieces.name: Penguin in a Scarf
pieces.note: A round penguin in a striped red scarf stands in the falling snow, its scarf tail flapping in the wind as it hops and flaps to keep warm.

pieces.name: Scatter Plot
pieces.note: Points landing one by one in a scatter plot of ad spend against revenue, then a fitted trend line drawing through them.

pieces.name: Ribbon Banner
pieces.note: A crimson ribbon banner with folded, notched tails, gold trim and a sheen sliding across the cloth.

pieces.name: Sea Cliff Puffins
pieces.note: Puffins with bright orange beaks stand and turn on a grassy clifftop above the sea, more whirring in from the waves past a sea stack ringed with surf.

pieces.name: Sea Link Night
pieces.note: A cable-stayed bridge sweeps across the bay at night, its fans of cables lit, as headlights and tail lights stream along the deck past the glittering city towers.

pieces.name: Sea Torii Sunset
pieces.note: A shrine gate stands in the sea as the sun sets between its posts, with waves rolling in and gulls crossing the sky.

pieces.name: Search Autocomplete
pieces.note: A search box where suggestions narrow and highlight with every keystroke, then a result is picked with the arrow keys.

pieces.name: Seasons From Axial Tilt
pieces.note: Earth circles the Sun with its axis always tilted 23.4 degrees the same way, so each hemisphere leans toward the Sun for summer and away for winter, shown in orbit and close up.

pieces.name: Seed Germination
pieces.note: A pea seed in the soil soaks up water, pushes its first root down, sends a hooked shoot up through the surface and opens its first leaves, with each stage and day labelled.

pieces.name: Sequence Diagram
pieces.note: A login sequence diagram where requests and dashed replies draw across the lifelines one after another.

pieces.name: Settings Toggles
pieces.note: A settings panel where a focus marker moves down the list, flipping switches and dragging sliders.

pieces.name: Vintage Sewing Machine
pieces.note: A black and gold vintage sewing machine whirs away, needle bobbing and handwheel turning as gingham fabric feeds through and a blue seam appears.

pieces.name: Sheet Music Playhead
pieces.note: A grand staff of sheet music scrolls past a fixed playhead, each note lighting up red as it sounds while the bars and bass line roll by.

pieces.name: Shikara Dal Lake
pieces.note: Painted shikaras glide across the mirror lake past carved wooden houseboats, autumn chinars and snow peaks, their boatmen paddling through the morning stillness.

pieces.name: Shore Temple Waves
pieces.note: The twin stepped towers of an ancient granite temple stand on the rocks at sunrise as the sea breaks white below them and fishermen walk down to their catamarans.

pieces.name: Sierpinski Triangle
pieces.note: The chaos game at work: a point hops halfway to random corners and a Sierpinski triangle appears out of the noise.

pieces.name: Simple Circuit Current
pieces.note: A switch closes and electrons drift from the negative terminal round through a resistor and a bulb, which lights, while meters show 6 volts, 12 ohms and half an amp.

pieces.name: Singing Mouth Choir
pieces.note: A cute choir of round faced singers in two rows, each part opening its mouth in turn for four part harmony while little notes float up from the stage.

pieces.name: Sitar String Pluck
pieces.note: A finger stops a fret on a sitar, the main string is plucked and blurs into a decaying vibration while sound rings spread out from the gourd.

pieces.name: Sizzling Skewer Grill
pieces.note: Three kebab skewers of meat, peppers and onion turn over glowing charcoal while flames lick up, fat spits and smoke rolls away.

pieces.name: Skeleton Loader
pieces.note: Shimmering skeleton placeholders for a feed of cards that dissolve into the real content.

pieces.name: Sleeping Cat
pieces.note: A ginger tabby curled up asleep on a red cushion, breathing slowly as little z's drift up into the warm room.

pieces.name: Drowsy Crescent Moon
pieces.note: A crescent moon in a striped nightcap rocks gently in the night sky, snoring little z's as soft clouds drift past below.

pieces.name: Slot Canyon Light
pieces.note: Inside a narrow sandstone slot canyon the swirling walls glow orange and violet as a shaft of sunlight slides across with sand sifting down through it.

pieces.name: Letter Slot Reels
pieces.note: A lever pulls, five reels of big letters blur past and thunk to a stop one by one to spell a word, and coins rattle into the tray.

pieces.name: Smart Home Panel
pieces.note: A home dashboard where lights flip on room by room, the thermostat climbs to its target, the door locks and the energy graph scrolls.

pieces.name: Rising Smoke Rings
pieces.note: A brick chimney puffs out smoke rings that rise, widen, wobble and slowly thin away into a dusky sky.

pieces.name: Snake
pieces.note: A self-playing snake that hunts the food on its own and starts over when it traps itself.

pieces.name: Slithering Snake
pieces.note: A banded green snake slithers across rippled desert sand in a smooth S curve, flicking its tongue and leaving a track.

pieces.name: Fox Trotting in Snow
pieces.note: A red fox trots through fresh powder past snowy pine woods, bushy tail swaying and paw prints trailing behind it as snow falls.

pieces.name: Snow Globe
pieces.note: A glass snow globe on a wooden base, holding a tiny lit cottage and a fir tree while snow swirls around them.

pieces.name: Snowfall Valley
pieces.note: Three layers of snow falling over a pine valley at night while the drifts slowly pile up.

pieces.name: Snowy Cabin
pieces.note: A log cabin glows in snowy woods at dusk while chimney smoke curls up and snow keeps falling.

pieces.name: Solar Flare Eruption
pieces.note: The boiling edge of the sun fills the frame while plasma runs along a glowing magnetic loop and a flare erupts, flinging bright matter into space.

pieces.name: Bubble vs Quick Sort
pieces.note: Bubble sort and quicksort race on the same shuffled bars, highlighting each comparison, swap and pivot, so quicksort finishes and waits while bubble sort is still carrying large values to the end.

pieces.name: Soup Ladle Service
pieces.note: A steel ladle dips into a steaming red pot of tomato soup and swings over to fill a row of white bowls one after another.

pieces.name: Sparkline Panel
pieces.note: Six labelled sparklines scrolling with their live values, trend arrows and a range bar.

pieces.name: Grinder Sparks
pieces.note: An angle grinder bites into a steel bar on a workbench, throwing a bright fan of sparks that arc down and bounce across the floor.

pieces.name: Spectrum Music Player
pieces.note: A music player window with bouncing spectrum bars, a moving progress bar and a playlist that advances track by track.

pieces.name: Speed Gauge
pieces.note: A semicircular speed test gauge with green to red bands and a needle swinging to the live reading.

pieces.name: Sphere to Cube Morph
pieces.note: A turning solid that swells from a smooth ball into a sharp cube and back, each of its six sides painted its own colour.

pieces.name: Spider Web
pieces.note: A spider spins an orb web at dusk, spoke by spoke and then round and round, until dew glints along the finished threads.

pieces.name: Spinner Set
pieces.note: Twelve classic terminal spinners side by side, each labelled with its name and frame count.

pieces.name: Spinning Gold Coin
pieces.note: A thick gold coin with a raised star and a ridged rim spinning on its edge, its shadow stretching and shrinking on the floor below.

pieces.name: Spinning Torus
pieces.note: A lit ring turning slowly on two axes, shaded with a classic character ramp.

pieces.name: Spiral Galaxy
pieces.note: A tilted spiral galaxy turns slowly, its golden core feeding two blue arms dotted with pink star nurseries.

pieces.name: Spirograph
pieces.note: A toothed wheel rolls inside a ring, its pen tracing hypotrochoid curves layered in colour, then a fresh set begins.

pieces.name: Split Flap Board
pieces.note: An airport departures board where every tile flaps through the alphabet to show the next flights.

pieces.name: Split Pane Multiplexer
pieces.note: A terminal multiplexer split into a streaming server log, a live resource meter and a test watcher, with focus hopping between panes.

pieces.name: Spreadsheet Recalc
pieces.note: A budget spreadsheet where a cell is edited, its formula bar updates and the dependent totals flash as they recalculate.

pieces.name: Spring Coil
pieces.note: A steel coil spring hanging from a beam, stretching and recoiling under a turning weight, lit with a bright metallic glint.

pieces.name: Spring Mass
pieces.note: Masses bob on coil springs at their own natural frequencies, and a coupled pair passes its energy back and forth between two normal modes.

pieces.name: Sprouting Pot Plant
pieces.note: A little pot plant on a sunny window sill catches a drop of water, slowly unfurls a brand new leaf and gives a big happy smile.

pieces.name: SQL Query Runner
pieces.note: A database console types a SQL query with highlighting, runs it and fills a result grid with rows and timing.

pieces.name: Secure Shell Login
pieces.note: A remote shell session that accepts a host key, prints a welcome banner with system stats, runs two commands and logs out.

pieces.name: Stacked Area Stream
pieces.note: A stacked area chart of requests per second from four regions, new samples streaming in on the right while the history slides away to the left.

pieces.name: Star History Climb
pieces.note: A star history chart draws itself week by week, flagging each milestone as the line climbs to your repo's star count.

pieces.name: Star Milestone
pieces.note: A gold star spins in, the star count rolls up to your milestone and confetti falls, with your repo name and a thank-you line you can change.

pieces.name: Star Rating Review
pieces.note: A review card where the cursor hovers across five stars, settles on a rating, writes a short review and posts it to the tally.

pieces.name: Starburst
pieces.note: Rainbow rays bursting from a white hot centre while rings pulse outward through them.

pieces.name: Starfield Warp
pieces.note: Hundreds of stars streak outward from the centre as the view punches through space at warp speed.

pieces.name: Starry Ridge
pieces.note: A violet sky full of stars and the Milky Way over a dark mountain ridge.

pieces.name: Twinkle Star Band
pieces.note: A narrow band of twinkling dots and four-pointed sparkles that bloom and fade in white, gold and lilac.

pieces.name: State Machine
pieces.note: A data fetching state machine where the active state lights up and a token runs each labelled transition, through errors and retries.

pieces.name: States Of Matter Particles
pieces.note: Three boxes of particles: a solid vibrating in a fixed lattice, a liquid sliding in a close jumble and a gas flying fast and far apart, with melting, boiling and their reverses marked.

pieces.name: Stencil Spray Paint
pieces.note: A spray can zigzags over a card stencil taped to a brick wall, the stencil peels away to reveal the painted word, and a roller paints it over.

pieces.name: Stilt Village Sunset
pieces.note: Thatched huts stand on stilts over calm water as the sun sets, while two fishing boats row home, smoke rises and birds fly over.

pieces.name: Stock Ticker
pieces.note: A market ticker tape of made-up symbols scrolling past with green and red arrows, prices and percent changes.

pieces.name: Stomping Little Dino
pieces.note: A chubby little green dinosaur stomps in place under a smoking volcano, kicking up dust, flailing its tiny arms and letting out a big roar.

pieces.name: Stone Pillar Forest
pieces.note: Towering sandstone pillars crowned with pines rise out of a sea of cloud that flows between them, a cable car gliding across the gorge and birds threading the gaps.

pieces.name: Stonehenge Solstice Dawn
pieces.note: The ancient stone circle at dawn on the solstice, the sun rising through its stones while ground mist drifts between them and sheep graze the plain.

pieces.name: Studio Mixing Desk
pieces.note: A studio mixing console with twelve channel strips, faders gliding on automation, LED meters bouncing and two needle VU meters on the master bus.

pieces.name: Subduction Zone Volcano
pieces.note: A cross-section where an oceanic plate dives under a continent at a trench, melts in the hot mantle and feeds magma up into an erupting volcano, every layer labelled.

pieces.name: Subtitle Captions
pieces.note: A night rooftop scene plays in a video frame while timed captions appear with coloured speaker names, sound cues and a moving scrubber.

pieces.name: Sugarloaf Cable Car
pieces.note: Rio's bay at golden hour, with cable cars climbing to the top of the domed granite peak, sailboats crossing, frigatebirds gliding and palms swaying on the beach.

pieces.name: Hot Afternoon Cooler
pieces.note: A hot afternoon indoors: the ceiling fan whirls, the desert cooler blows the curtains about and the wall calendar flips from one scorching day to the next.

pieces.name: Summit Above Clouds
pieces.note: A snowy peak glows pink above a drifting sea of cloud at sunrise while a roped line of climbers walks the ridge below.

pieces.name: Sun Temple Chariot Wheel
pieces.note: The giant carved stone chariot wheel of the sun temple glows at golden hour, the shadows of its spokes turning across its face as parakeets dart past the tiered temple roof.

pieces.name: Sunrise Horizon
pieces.note: The sun climbs over a flat sea horizon while the sky shifts from deep night through dawn pinks to clear day.

pieces.name: Supertree Grove Night
pieces.note: Tall steel supertrees glow magenta, violet and teal at night beside a city skyline, while people stroll the garden path and cross the high skywalk.

pieces.name: Sushi Conveyor Belt
pieces.note: Colour rimmed plates of salmon, tuna, egg and prawn nigiri and cucumber maki glide past on a steel belt below a swaying indigo curtain.

pieces.name: Swimming Whale
pieces.note: A humpback whale glides beneath the waves through shafts of light, rising now and then to blow a spout.

pieces.name: Switchback Dusk Drive
pieces.note: Cars wind down a switchback mountain road at dusk, headlights sweeping the bends under an orange afterglow while the first stars come out.

pieces.name: Syntax Highlight Pass
pieces.note: Code is typed into an editor as plain grey text, then the language is detected and syntax colour sweeps down the file line by line.

pieces.name: Synthwave Grid
pieces.note: A neon grid rushing toward a striped sunset sun, with purple hills on the horizon.

pieces.name: Tab Bar
pieces.note: An editor tab bar where the active underline slides between files and the content swaps beneath.

pieces.name: Tabla Teental Hands
pieces.note: Two hands play a sixteen beat teental theka on a tabla pair, each stroke rippling the drum heads while the bols light up in a strip above.

pieces.name: Table Mountain Harbour
pieces.note: The flat-topped mountain stands over the city and harbour as its tablecloth of cloud pours over the edge, a yacht sails across and gulls wheel above the masts.

pieces.name: Taj Mahal Sunset
pieces.note: A white domed mausoleum with four minarets glows at sunset above its long reflecting pool.

pieces.name: Tap Tempo Counter
pieces.note: A tap tempo tool where each tap flashes the pad with a ripple while the BPM readout settles, the intervals chart fills and the beat lights lock in.

pieces.name: TCP Handshake Ladder
pieces.note: A packet ladder diagram where SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK step down between client and server, followed by a request, its reply and the four-way close, with each socket state logged as it changes.

pieces.name: Tea Poured From Height
pieces.note: A silver teapot is lifted high as it pours a long amber stream of mint tea into a small gold-rimmed glass, foam rising and steam curling.

pieces.name: Teleprompter Script
pieces.note: A speech script scrolls up a prompter screen past a marked reading line, with stage cues, a recording light and a running timer.

pieces.name: Teletype Paper Roll
pieces.note: A teletype prints a time-sharing session onto a roll of paper, the type head running along each line, keys going down as the user types and the paper feeding upward.

pieces.name: Temple Gopuram Madurai
pieces.note: A towering temple gateway rises in tiers crowded with painted figures in a hundred colours as pigeons circle it and pilgrims pass the gate in the morning light.

pieces.name: Temple Sunset
pieces.note: A cliff-top temple in bougainvillea above a calm sea at sunset.

pieces.name: Terminal Session
pieces.note: A shell session where commands are typed at a coloured prompt and their output streams back.

pieces.name: Terraced Lakes Falls
pieces.note: Turquoise lakes step down through an autumn forest, waterfalls pouring over the mossy lips between them, as walkers cross the wooden boardwalk and leaves drift down.

pieces.name: Terrain Mesh Flyover
pieces.note: A low flight over an endless gridded landscape, green valleys rising to rocky ridges and snowy peaks that sweep toward the camera under a dusk sky.

pieces.name: Tesseract
pieces.note: A four dimensional hypercube turning through the fourth axis, its inner and outer cubes swapping places as it projects down.

pieces.name: Test Suite Dots
pieces.note: A test runner that prints a dot per passing test across files, flags a failure with a diff and ends in a coloured summary.

pieces.name: Tethered Spacewalk
pieces.note: An astronaut drifts on a curling tether beside a station hull, waving now and then, while the cloudy blue earth turns slowly far below.

pieces.name: Lighthouse Text Adventure
pieces.note: A text adventure in an old lighthouse where the player types commands at the prompt, the parser answers, the score and move counter tick up and the light is lit at last.

pieces.name: Text Scramble
pieces.note: Random block letters churn and settle one slot at a time into a phrase, then scramble away into the next.

pieces.name: Thames Clock Tower
pieces.note: London's floodlit clock tower and gothic riverside front glow at dusk, as a red double-decker bus crosses the bridge and boats pass on the river below.

pieces.name: Thundering Falls Rainbow
pieces.note: A mile-wide curtain of water pours into a basalt gorge, spray boiling up out of it with a rainbow standing in the mist and the rainforest dripping at its edge.

pieces.name: Timeline
pieces.note: A horizontal company timeline where a moving marker reveals each milestone, labels popping up above and below the line.

pieces.name: Toast Stack
pieces.note: Notification toasts slide into the corner of an app, stack up, count down and slide away.

pieces.name: Toaster Pops Toast
pieces.note: A chrome toaster squints and glows as it concentrates, then pops two golden slices high into the air and catches them with a grin.

pieces.name: Token Bucket Limiter
pieces.note: A token bucket rate limiter where tokens drip in at a fixed rate, each request spends one on its way to the API, and a sudden burst drains the bucket so the overflow is turned away with 429s.

pieces.name: Tokyo Crossing
pieces.note: Crowds stream across a scramble crossing at night beneath walls of glowing, flickering billboards.

pieces.name: Torii Gate Tunnel
pieces.note: A stone path runs through hundreds of vermilion shrine gates into the green forest light while a walker climbs the path and leaves drift down.

pieces.name: Tornado
pieces.note: A twisting tornado funnel snakes across open plains under a green storm sky, flinging dust and debris around its base.

pieces.name: Torus Knot
pieces.note: A glossy tube tied in a trefoil torus knot, turning slowly, lit and depth-sorted so it passes over and under itself.

pieces.name: Tower Bridge Lift
pieces.note: The twin-towered bridge at golden hour lifts its two road decks to let a tall ship sail through, then lowers them again as gulls wheel over the river.

pieces.name: Tower Defence Wave
pieces.note: Waves of creeps march along a winding dirt road while cannon, frost and laser towers built beside it hold the line.

pieces.name: Trace Span Waterfall
pieces.note: A distributed tracing waterfall where nested spans for each service grow along a millisecond axis as a checkout request runs, followed by a slower trace whose payment call times out and retries.

pieces.name: Traffic Light
pieces.note: A street crossing where the signal cycles green, amber and red while cars stop, queue and pull away.

pieces.name: Train at Dusk
pieces.note: A passenger train with glowing windows crosses a stone viaduct over a misty valley at dusk.

pieces.name: Transverse And Longitudinal
pieces.note: A wave on a string, where each bead moves up and down, above a sound wave in air, where each particle moves back and forth, with wavelength, compressions and rarefactions marked.

pieces.name: Disk Usage Treemap
pieces.note: A treemap of disk usage by folder, the boxes growing, shrinking and trading places as caches fill and logs rotate.

pieces.name: Candy Trefoil Tube
pieces.note: A fat red and cream striped tube tied in a trefoil knot, the stripes flowing around the loop while the knot slowly turns.

pieces.name: Tropical Island
pieces.note: Swaying palms on a small island ringed by turquoise water, waves lapping under a high sun.

pieces.name: Truchet Tiles
pieces.note: A grid of quarter-circle Truchet tiles turning in rippling waves, the tubes re-routing into new flowing paths.

pieces.name: Tulip Fields Windmill
pieces.note: Stripes of tulips in pink, yellow, white, coral and lilac run to a windmill whose sails turn against a big sky as a cyclist rides the farm path.

pieces.name: Texture Tunnel
pieces.note: A flight down an endless checkered tunnel that bends and twists as it goes.

pieces.name: Turquoise Lake Canoe
pieces.note: A red canoe glides across an impossibly turquoise lake ringed by jagged peaks and dark pines, morning mist lifting off the water around it.

pieces.name: TV Static
pieces.note: An untuned television full of snowy static, a brighter bar rolling slowly down the screen.

pieces.name: Twin Pane Commander
pieces.note: A retro two-pane file manager where the cursor picks files, a copy dialog fills its progress bar and the files land in the other pane.

pieces.name: Twin Spires Night
pieces.note: Two silver skyscrapers joined by a sky bridge glow over the city at night as the fountains dance in the park pool and a plane blinks across the sky.

pieces.name: Typebar Close-Up
pieces.note: A close-up inside a typewriter: one typebar after another swings up from the fanned basket to strike the ribbon, and letters appear on the paper as the carriage steps along.

pieces.name: Typewriter
pieces.note: Big block letters typed one key at a time behind a block cursor, wrapping onto new lines before the page clears.

pieces.name: Underwater Reef
pieces.note: A coral reef where fish swim through shafts of light falling from the surface as bubbles rise.

pieces.name: Unfolding Poem
pieces.note: An original poem is written out line by line behind a pen cursor, each letter settling from faint to full ink, then lifts away for the next poem.

pieces.name: Upload Dropzone
pieces.note: A cursor drags a stack of files onto a drop zone that lights up, then each file uploads with its own progress bar.

pieces.name: Status Page
pieces.note: A service status page with daily uptime bars sliding along and the occasional incident turning a service amber or red.

pieces.name: Valentine Hearts
pieces.note: Shaded red and pink hearts of every size float upwards and sway through a warm rose haze.

pieces.name: Vaporwave Sun
pieces.note: A striped retro sun sinks into a scrolling neon grid sea while cloud streaks drift past and a CRT roll bar slides down the screen.

pieces.name: Varanasi Morning Boats
pieces.note: Wooden rowing boats cross the misty river at sunrise below the ghats, temples and palaces stacked up the bank as gulls skim the water and bathers step down.

pieces.name: Vector Space Duel
pieces.note: Two wireframe ships circle a flickering star on a green vector display, firing torpedoes, leaving phosphor trails, until one breaks apart and respawns.

pieces.name: Venice Gondola Canal
pieces.note: A canal between old palaces in late sun, their colours mirrored in the green water as a gondolier rows through and pigeons cross the sky.

pieces.name: Venn Diagram

pieces.name: Vertical Haiku Scroll

pieces.name: Viaduct Steam Train
pieces.note: An old steam train crosses a tall arched stone viaduct between the mountains, puffing steam as mist drifts through the valley.

pieces.name: Victoria Harbour Junk
pieces.note: Hong Kong's towers glow below the dark peak at night as a junk with red battened sails crosses the harbour and two ferries ply between the shores.

pieces.name: Vinyl Crate Digging
pieces.note: A hand digs through a wooden crate of records, tipping each sleeve forward to reveal the next bold cover with its price sticker.

pieces.name: Volcano Eruption
pieces.note: A volcano erupts into the night, throwing up lava bombs while glowing rivers run down its sides.

pieces.name: Voronoi Cells
pieces.note: Fourteen drifting seed points and the Voronoi regions they claim, shaded like moving stained glass.

pieces.name: Voxel Heart
pieces.note: A chunky heart built from small red cubes, turning slowly and giving a double beat every couple of seconds.

pieces.name: Waffle Iron Opening

pieces.name: Happy Wagging Pup
pieces.note: A floppy eared puppy sits in a sunny park, wagging its tail, panting with its tongue out and tilting its head as if asked a question.

pieces.name: Walking Dog
pieces.note: A golden dog trots happily along a park path, tail wagging and ears bouncing while the trees and clouds roll by.

pieces.name: Walled City Adriatic
pieces.note: The old city's orange roofs climb the hill behind its massive pale sea walls and round towers as sailboats cross the deep blue water below and gulls wheel overhead.

pieces.name: Washing Machine
pieces.note: A front loading washer tumbling a colourful load through soapy water, then draining and spinning fast.

pieces.name: Pool Caustics
pieces.note: Shimmering networks of light dancing across the tiled floor of a swimming pool.

pieces.name: Water Cycle Diagram
pieces.note: Water evaporates from the sea, condenses into a cloud, rains on the mountains and runs back to the sea above and below ground, with every stage labelled.

pieces.name: Waterfall Canyon
pieces.note: A tall waterfall drops between striped canyon walls into a green pool, throwing up spray and mist.

pieces.name: Waterfall
pieces.note: A tall waterfall pours between dark mossy cliffs into a churning pool, throwing up spray and drifting mist.

pieces.name: Wave Divider
pieces.note: Two soft sine waves roll across a thin band, their colour drifting from blue to pink to orange.

pieces.name: Wave Function Collapse
pieces.note: A terrain map is solved by wave function collapse, the lowest entropy tile collapsing first and every choice narrowing what its neighbours can become.

pieces.name: Wave Interference
pieces.note: Two vibrating sources send out circular waves that reinforce and cancel, carving the classic fan of nodal lines as the sources drift apart.

pieces.name: Wave Text
pieces.note: Big block letters bob along a travelling sine wave, brightening at each crest, with shadows that shrink as they rise.

pieces.name: Weather City Widget
pieces.note: A weather widget that slides from city to city, each with an animated sky icon, hourly temperatures and a five day outlook.

pieces.name: White Mosque Reflections
pieces.note: The great white mosque with its many domes and four minarets glows at blue hour, mirrored in long pools as the colonnade lamps come on and visitors stroll by.

pieces.name: White Salt Desert Moon
pieces.note: The endless white salt desert glows under a full moon, its crust cracked into hexagons, as a camel cart crosses the horizon and musicians play beside a small fire.

pieces.name: White Travertine Pools
pieces.note: White mineral terraces cascade down a hillside, each scalloped pool holding the evening sky, as water trickles over the lips, people wade the pools and paragliders drift overhead.

pieces.name: Wind Through Grass
pieces.note: A field of tall grass bends and shimmers silver as gusts of wind roll across it under a summer sky.

pieces.name: Windmill on a Hill
pieces.note: An old windmill on a green hill, its lattice sails turning above a striped tulip field at sunset.

pieces.name: Window Tiling Manager
pieces.note: A desktop where windows open one by one and the tiling layout slides between halves, columns and a grid.

pieces.name: Wireframe City Flyby
pieces.note: A night flight down a long avenue between wireframe towers, cyan and magenta edges racing past over a gridded street.

pieces.name: Wireframe Globe
pieces.note: A wire sphere of latitude and longitude lines turning on a tilted axis, near lines bright and far lines dim behind.

pieces.name: Line Drawn Maze Crawl
pieces.note: An early first-person maze game drawn in amber lines, gliding down corridors and turning at junctions by the right-hand rule while a map tracks each step.

pieces.name: Word Exchange
pieces.note: Everyday words trade like shares on a quote screen, with a crawling tape, a table of prices that tick up and down and a chart for the word of the hour.

pieces.name: Word Ladder Morph
pieces.note: A word ladder where one big letter at a time dissolves and re-forms into its neighbour, turning COLD into WARM while the steps are listed beside it.

pieces.name: World Map Pings
pieces.note: A dotted world map where live request pings flare up in cities and arcs carry traffic between them.

pieces.name: Yawning Coffee Mug
pieces.note: A sleepy coffee mug on its saucer gives a long stretchy yawn as curls of steam rise, then blinks itself wide awake.

pieces.name: Zigzag Rule
pieces.note: A doubled zigzag rule that scrolls sideways while a rainbow gradient slides along it.
